GAP: the outcome row 'strict SSH, firewall purge off with ignore patterns, and the boot run' maps the purge-off part to production-parameters-strict-keep-and-boot-run, but that probe reads only the INPUT policy, the '110 SSH' rule count and the boot unit/script; with no unmanaged rule present it reads the same whether node_base forwards firewall_strict_purge false / firewall_ignore_patterns (node_base.pp:101 -> firewall_secure.pp:37-46) or not. Production sets these on 11 node statements, and the lab CAN exercise it: firewall_secure.yml's keep variant does with mutating checks (unmanaged rules added, agent run, the rule matching the ignore pattern kept, the other purged). The prod variant needs such a check (rule matching p8test-keep kept, a non-matching one purged), or the row must not claim it.
